title: Fields Schema
description: Defines scalar, vector/spin, and resonance-envelope fields for the Resonance Substrate Model (RSM). Includes field values, gradients, coherence, and cross-field coupling parameters.

scalar_field.description: The scalar field φ representing baseline substrate potential.

value.description: Scalar field magnitude at a given point.

gradient.description: Spatial gradient of the scalar field.

units.description: Optional unit system for the scalar field.

vector_field.description: The vector/spin field V⃗ representing directional or spin-based substrate behavior.

magnitude.description: Computed or provided magnitude of the vector field.

resonance_envelope.description: The resonance envelope R describing coherence, amplitude, and phase alignment.

amplitude.description: Resonance amplitude at a given point.

coupling.description: Cross-field coupling strengths between scalar, vector, and resonance fields.

scalar_to_vector.description: Coupling strength from scalar to vector field.

vector_to_resonance.description: Coupling strength from vector field to resonance envelope.

scalar_to_resonance.description: Coupling strength from scalar field to resonance envelope.

metadata.description: Optional metadata for documentation, provenance, or schema evolution.
